Exploration Silence or Danger replaces that roll: Silence means no roll/no effect (unless Slime turns it into Danger); Danger means do not roll, and move all eligible neighboring Intruders into the Room, or, if none are eligible, put Noise in every connected Corridor that lacks it. If the destination already contains any Character or Intruder, do not make a Noise roll. The Exploration token is removed from the game into the box after resolution.

If ship survives to checks: two/three Damaged explodes kills all aboard incl Intruders; non-Earth kills sleepers but ship/Intruders survive, Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. grades.observed_answer: The Victory Check order is Engines, Coordinates, Contamination, then Objectives. If two Engines are Damaged, the ship explodes and everything aboard dies, including hibernating Characters and Intruders; launched Pods are already away. If the ship is headed somewhere other than Earth, hibernating Characters die, except a Character with the Quarantine Objective survives hibernation if the destination is Mars. That Objective requires Mars, and the summary also states a ship-reach-Earth/Mars objective requires the right Coordinates and at least 2 Working Engines. For Contamination, each surviving Character, evacuated or hibernating, is checked: scan all cards; if any is Infected, shuffle all cards and draw four, and any Contamination card among those four kills. A Larva triggers that draw-four test directly, skipping the initial scan. Thus Pod passengers do need the Contamination check.

grades.question: Give the endgame checks in order. What happens with two Damaged Engines, a non-Earth destination (including Quarantine/Mars), and an infected survivor or one carrying a Larva? Do pod passengers need Contamination checks?

If two Engines are Damaged, the ship explodes and everything aboard dies, including hibernating Characters and Intruders; launched Pod passengers are already away. If the ship survived but is not headed to Earth, Hibernatorium sleepers die; the Quarantine Objective holder survives hibernation if the destination is Mars. Then each surviving Character, including Pod evacuees, checks Contamination: scan all cards in deck, discard, and hand. If at least one is Infected, shuffle all cards and draw four; any Contamination among those four kills them. A Character with a Larva skips the initial scan and takes that same shuffle-and-draw-four test directly. Finally, survivors reveal Objectives and win if requirements are met. Pod passengers do need the Contamination check.
